description:
This file defines the Review model class within the Opencart 
Catalog module. It contains methods for adding reviews, retrieving reviews 
by product ID, and getting total reviews count for a product.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: The Review class manages product reviews, allowing addition and retrieval of reviews related to products.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Adds a new review for a specific product, inserting review data into the database and returning the new review ID.

methods.name: getReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Fetches a list of reviews for a specified product ID, supporting pagination with start and limit parameters.

methods.name: getTotalReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Returns the total count of reviews for a specified product ID.
